steps.en: Slowly add more fibre, like fruit and oats.
steps.hi: धीरे-धीरे फ़ाइबर बढ़ाइए, जैसे फल और ओट्स।
steps.hinglish: Dheere dheere fibre badhaiye, jaise phal aur oats.

steps.en: Walk or stay active every day.
Do not delay when you feel the urge to go.
steps.hi: शौच की इच्छा हो तो देर मत कीजिए।
steps.hinglish: Potty ka mann ho to der mat kijiye.

seeDoctorIf.en: It does not get better with these steps.
seeDoctorIf.hi: इन उपायों से ठीक न हो।
seeDoctorIf.hinglish: In upayon se theek na ho.

seeDoctorIf.en: There is blood in your stool.
You have stomach pain, or feel tired all the time.
seeDoctorIf.hi: पेट में दर्द हो, या हर समय थकान रहे।
seeDoctorIf.hinglish: Pet mein dard ho, ya har samay thakan rahe.
